title: Local augmented Koszul carrier
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion] with additive tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix V open in Z and an affine open U in Y. Write A=Gamma(Y,U), I=ker(i)(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Fix m and f:Fin(m)\to A with span(range(f))=I, and a projective resolution Q of A/I whose chain complex equals the Koszul complex K(A,m,f) [new-j3-koszul-projective-resolution]. Let F be termwise restriction to U, S=(i_*O_Z)[0], and G be termwise tensor pullback along i followed by restriction to V and its over site W=V intersect i^{-1}(U) [lem-sc-homology-evaluation-formal-complex]. There exist a cochain complex K on Y [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and an augmentation b:F(K)\to F(S) which is a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex], such that G(K) has zero differentials, terms zero outside some finite integer interval, and in every degree a finite free basis over the localized ring sheaf. No input resolution P is involved, and no comparison roof is asserted.

source.place: Local Koszul complex in the proof; Tag 068C finite-free quotient resolution; reindexing and chart pushforward provide a carrier on Y.

proof.text: Extend Q.pi along embeddingDownNat and compose with extendSingleIso to get an integer-indexed quotient augmentation. Transport its source with hQ. Mathlib preserves quasi-isomorphisms under extension. Apply affine_koszul_finite_free_resolution to obtain the explicit sheafified Koszul complex E on U, its bounded-above finite-free terms, and its quasi-isomorphic augmentation a.

Define K termwise as pushforward of E along U.ι. The Mathlib restriction-pushforward counit gives c:F(K) ≅ E. Compose c.hom, a, and the inverse singleMapHomologicalComplex comparison to construct b:F(K) → F(S). Every comparison is invertible, so b is a quasi-isomorphism.

The tensor unit is flat by its unitor and the proved abstract flat_of_tensorIso lemma. A free sheaf is its coproduct, hence flat by isFlat_coproduct. Transport flatness through the displayed finite-free term isomorphisms and c. Transport the upper bound through c and apply isKFlat_of_boundedAbove_flat_ringedSpace. This proves K-flatness only on U, as required.

For every ring map φ killing the generators, koszulBaseChangeIso identifies scalar extension with the Koszul complex on the zero sequence. Its contraction differential is zero since contraction is linear in the zero functional. Extension by zero preserves this calculation: positive cochain terms are zero and the other differential components are conjugates of the chain differentials. On the affine source X=i^{-1}(U), the chart ring map is i.app(U) followed by the inverse top-open identification. Every f_j lies in ker(i)(U) by hf, so this map kills f_j. Use tensorPullback_tilde_iso, uniqueness of open pullback adjoints and tensor pullback composition to transport the algebraic zero calculation through the affine charts. Factor the map W→U through X. The open pullback square and restriction-pushforward counit identify the local carrier with this pullback of E. Finally use the faithful over-site equivalence to detect zero differentials in G(K). All isomorphisms act on the actual constructed complexes.

In exterior degree q>m the exterior basis is indexed by an empty powersetCard, hence its module is zero. In positive cochain degree extension has zero terms. Thus E is supported in [-m,0]. Pushforward, tensor pullback and open-over restriction preserve zero objects, giving the same bound for G(K).

In each degree, restrict K back to U and identify it through c with the finite-free term of E. Tensor pullback preserves coproducts as a left adjoint and preserves the unit by tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso, so it preserves free modules with their same rank. For W=V^{-1}(i^{-1}(U)), factor W→Y through U. Pullback composition and uniqueness of the left adjoint along an open immersion give the natural open square. Combine this with restriction composition and overIsoFreeEquiv to obtain the required free isomorphism over V/W. Empty ranks, empty opens, m=0 and zero rings require no nontriviality hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_koszul_augmented_carrier
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive]
    (V : Z.Opens) (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (Q : ProjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
      ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U)))
    (hQ : Q.complex = ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) m f) :
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let S := (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor Z V (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
    ∃ (K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (b : F.obj K ⟶ F.obj S),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := U.1.toScheme.sheaf) b ∧
      (∀ x y : ℤ, (G.obj K).d x y = 0) ∧
      (∃ x y : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < x ∨ y < k → IsZero ((G.obj K).X k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty ((G.obj K).X k ≅
        SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over
          (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
